# Awesome Agent Skills

A curated list of Claude Skills for developers.

## Code Review

- [Code Reviewer](https://github.com/voltagent/code-reviewer) — Production-grade code review skill that catches bugs, suggests refactors, and scores PRs. License: MIT.
- [Test Author](https://github.com/voltagent/test-author) — Generates Vitest/Playwright suites for the file you're editing. License: MIT.

## Productivity

- [Refactor Helper](https://github.com/voltagent/refactor-helper) — Suggests refactors based on the code you're editing. License: Apache-2.0.
